raw: {"status": "NO_PLAN", "reasons": ["Conflicting mandatory constraints: CS2105 and CS3211 both require IS1108 in the same semester, but CS2105 and CS3211 have mutually exclusive prerequisites (CS2105 requires CS2040S/CS2040/etc which is completed, but CS3211 requires CS2106/CG2271 which is completed; however, the main conflict is that CS2105 and CS3211 cannot be taken together if they are mutually exclusive or if their prerequisites block each other. Actually, CS2105 and CS3211 are not mutually exclusive. The conflict is that the student must take CS2105 and IS1108 together, AND CS3211 and IS1108 together. This implies CS2105, CS3211, and IS1108 must all be in the same semester. However, CS2105 has prerequisite CS2040S (completed). CS3211 has prerequisite CS2106 (completed). IS1108 has no prerequisite. So they can be taken together. But wait, CS2105 is offered Sem 1 and Sem 2. CS3211 is offered Sem 2 only. IS1108 is offered Sem 1 and Sem 2. So they can all be taken in Sem 2 (Y4S2). The student is in Y4S2 (Semester 8). The student says 'I must take IS1108 in year 4 semester 2' and 'I must take CS3227 in year 4 semester 2'. CS3227 prerequisite is CS2103/CS2103T/CS2113/CS2103DE. Student has CS2103T. So CS3227 is eligible. So in Sem 8, the student must take CS2105, CS3211, IS1108, CS3227, and CS4247. CS4247 prerequisite is CS3241. Student has NOT completed CS3241. CS3241 is offered Sem 1 only. It is not offered in Sem 8. Therefore, CS4247 cannot be taken in Sem 8 because its prerequisite CS3241 was not taken in a previous semester (and cannot be taken in Sem 8 as it's not offered). The student has no more semesters after Sem 8. Thus, no plan exists."]
